_about: Seasonality and rule notes used by fishon_engine.species. Every non-null claim carries a source. 'how' strings are general angling tips, not sourced facts. Months are 1-12. Species/spot combos not listed are treated as 'no seasonal data' (shown, never invented). Checked 2026-10-25 NZDT; kingfish (Cook Strait/East Cape/Hawke Bay) and Southern Lakes added 2026-10-26 NZDT.

entries.how: soft-baits or berleyed baits along reef edges and work-ups
entries.note: Inshore spawning aggregations Oct-Mar, peak Nov-Dec; spawning starts at roughly 14.8-16 C sea temperature.
sources: Parsons et al. 2014, 'Snapper (Chrysophrys auratus): a review of life history and key vulnerabilities in New Zealand', NZ J Marine & Freshwater Research 48(2). https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/00288330.2014.892013
NIWA: spring spawning migrations at about 16 C. https://niwa.co.nz/news/will-it-be-fintastic-fishing-year

closed.rule: Marlborough Sounds blue cod season closed 1 Sep - 10 Jan inclusive (extended Aug 2025).

entries.note: Recreational southern bluefin tuna fishery off the west coast of the South Island runs January-August (2024-25 season Dec-Aug; Fiordland usually starts in January; Greymouth catches highest Jul-Aug).
sources: Fisheries NZ, FAR 2025/52 'Recreational harvest of southern bluefin tuna in New Zealand 2024-25'. https://fs.fish.govt.nz/Doc/26187/FAR-2025-52-Recreational-harvest-southern-bluefin-tuna-New-Zealand-2024-25.pdf.ashx

entries.how: spin or fly from the shore at first and last light
entries.note: Lakes Wanaka, Hawea, Wakatipu and Dunstan are open all year (bag 2 trout + 4 salmon on the main lakes). Many rivers close 30 Apr - check the Otago Fish & Game regulations. A licence is required.
sources: Fish & Game NZ, Otago winter fishing. https://www.fishandgame.org.nz/freshwater-fishing-in-new-zealand/where-to-fish/winter-fishing/otago/

entries.how: spin or fly from the shore at first and last light
entries.note: Lakes Te Anau and Manapouri (incl. Waiau Arm) are open all year, bag 2 trout (salmon 1 of them per the regulations' notes); their tributaries are open 1 Nov - 31 May only. A Fish & Game licence is required.
sources: Fish & Game NZ, Southland Sports Fishing Regulations 2026-27 (Anglers Notice for Fish and Game Regions 2026, in force 1 Oct 2026), Southland lakes table: Lake Te Anau 'All year', Lake Manapouri including Waiau Arm 'All year', tributaries 1 Nov - 31 May. https://www.fishandgame.org.nz/assets/Fishing/Fishing-Licences-Regulations/Fishing-Regulations/2026/2027/Fish-and-Game-Sportsfishing-Regs-Brochure-2026-27-Southland.pdf

entries.note: Fisheries NZ: in Cook Strait kingfish are encountered mainly in summer, and from East Cape to Hawke Bay most kingfish fishing occurs in summer. Months here = NZ summer (Dec-Feb); the source gives seasons, not months.
sources: Holdsworth, McKenzie, Walsh, van der Straten & O Maolagain 2013, 'Catch-at-age of yellowtail kingfish (Seriola lalandi) caught by recreational fishers in KIN 1', NZ Fisheries Assessment Report 2013/3, p. 4 (citing Holdsworth et al. 2007). https://webstatic.niwa.co.nz/library/FAR-2013-3.pdf
